segments.subgoal: Explain why understanding visual perception, light propagation, and lenses is important for VR headset design, virtual world rendering, camera placement, and tracking.

Distinguish central and peripheral vision based on the distribution of cones and rods in the retina.
Explain what the blind spot is and why it occurs because of the optic nerve's passage through the retina.
Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next part on headsets and displays.
